name: Immortal Obligation
oracle_text: Return target creature card from an opponent's graveyard to the battlefield under their control with a duty counter on it. For as long as that creature has a duty counter on it, it is goaded, can't attack you or a permanent you control, and can't block creatures you control.
blocked_sentences: For as long as that creature has a duty counter on it, it is goaded, can't attack you or a permanent you control, and can't block creatures you control.

needs.what: a `while_counter` duration (with `counter` naming the kind) on the `goad` op, so the creature stays goaded by the spell's controller for as long as it has a duty counter on it, and stops being goaded when the last one is removed
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `goad` takes only `duration: "permanent"` (rest of the game) or the default until-the-goader's-next-turn clock; neither ends when a counter is removed. Only `cant_attack_player` with `objects` has a `while_counter` mark (`structs.AttackMark`)

needs.what: a per-object block restriction lasting `while_counter` that forbids the creature from blocking only attackers controlled by the spell's controller ("can't block creatures you control"), not blocking in general
needs.why_existing_wont_do: the `cant_block` op forbids all blocking and only lasts `this_turn` or `until_your_next_turn` (`BLOCK_PROHIBITION_DURATIONS`); the `block_restriction` and `cant_block` statics need a source on the battlefield and a printed-characteristics filter, and an instant leaves no source
